caseName: Raleigh v. Illinois Department of Revenue
caseNameFull: Raleigh, Chapter 7 Trustee for the Estate of Stoecker v. Illinois Department of Revenue

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, February 22, 2000. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Thursday, March 23,2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 10, 2000. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
